row.title: TRAJECTORY-1: model time, not snapshots; the simulator iterates from observed trajectories
row.body: seed/scripts/trajectory.py keeps per-day series per area, loop ledger and issue stream from git and ops ledgers; reads hotspot, neglect and drift; observed event rates and trends replace assumed fault rates in the year simulation (rate_from, growth thinning). History is 12 days deep today, so only series with at least 3 events are used; the rest keep stated rates. Shown at /year.
